Based on the information provided, Sara and her husband both have a family history of asthma, which significantly increases the likelihood that their baby may develop asthma or have a predisposition to respiratory issues. The baby’s symptoms of wheezing and shortness of breath, particularly at night, are classic indicators of potential asthma or reactive airway disease. These symptoms warrant immediate medical evaluation to confirm a diagnosis and establish an appropriate management plan. Early intervention can help prevent severe episodes and improve the child's quality of life.
